known_secrets.text: Luma quietly checks on Elira's wellbeing without Tarek's knowledge.
She regrets not opposing Elira's erasure more forcefully at the time.
She has independently connected the thinning woodland, spreading salt, failing terraces, and sick cattle into one pattern no one else has assembled.
She intends to bring this synthesis to Tarek but hasn't yet.

unknowns: Whether the six clans' separate problems truly share one root cause
What exactly will happen when she tells Tarek her synthesis
Meaning of the Signs on the seals
